goal.objective: Reduce end-to-end latency of the existing local OpenCode voice plugin and its manual transcript-review workflow, without changing the OpenCode executable/frontend, adding native-composer integration, auto-sending manual dictation, or sacrificing accuracy, offline/in-memory privacy, session isolation, cancellation or cleanup. Reuse the already-verified Sherpa recognizer and prior acoustic evidence; profile and optimize cold readiness, recognition finalization, response sentence buffering and speech startup with numeric-only timing evidence and behavior regressions. Prepare the existing opt-in Sherpa rollout while preserving separate approval gates for active dependency/model installation, native configuration deployment, TUI reload/shared restart, live message submission and commit/push; verify source improvements independently of any blocked live rollout.

plan.summary: Optimize the existing review-based voice plugin and add a settings-configurable microphone toggle plus15-second recognized-speech inactivity auto-off; keep host unchanged and rollout approvals separate.
completionCriteria: Numeric-only baseline and after-change timings identify latency stages without logging audio or transcript content.
Verified source improvements reduce a measured startup or first-speech delay while retaining recognition accuracy, manual review, session cancellation and cleanup.
Opt-in Sherpa rollout is prepared and actual installed/loaded/live status is honestly verified or explicitly blocked on separate approval.
Relevant regression, type/lint and integration checks pass; remaining provider/live-workflow limitations are explicit.

phases.objective: Preserve existing work and identify measured latency bottlenecks.

tasks.evidence: Scoped status/diffs preserve prior source and untracked tests. Production startup/capture/controller paths eagerly loaded Sherpa, large Vosk wake model and Piper before ready; replies waited for full sentences. Network-disabled/read-only-root native probe measured construct17906.97ms, manual stream122.87ms, first synthesis512.70ms, warm synthesis277.31ms, wake recognizer258.93ms; no devices, saved audio or user prompts.

phases.verification: Actual native timing baseline and source review agree on unnecessary eager model work. Prior recognition/acoustic tests remain retained, not re-executed as discovery.

phases.objective: Implement targeted latency improvements and requested microphone controls without degrading safeguards.

tasks.description: Decouple unnecessary speech-output work from microphone readiness and verify real startup improvement.

Faster ready only, not claimed faster live reply. ACCEPTANCE.md retains all numeric results and caveat.

New session-bound prepare_speech warms Piper on existing owned playback loop before review/submit, never plays/submits unreviewed text, cancellation nonblocking, failure retryable. Python prewarm regressions failed before change and pass after. Maintained scripts/latency_probe.py plus tests report numeric model stages only. Native offline/read-only-root prepared run: construct4372.161ms, stream102.047ms, prepare5099.926ms, first synthesis379.112ms, warm287.585ms, wake3382.790ms. tasks.description: Add a settings-configurable listening-toggle hotkey and a15-second no-recognized-speech timeout. Off must stop microphone capture, not silently return to background wake listening or submit a message; synchronize visible mic state and cover shortcut changes, idle timer reset, stale events/session changes and cleanup.
tasks.evidence: Implemented stored hotkey presets (unassigned/F9/F10/Ctrl+G), reactive owned keymap command voice.microphone.toggle and shared mouse/shortcut toggle. Native microphone_off stops capture without submitting/muting playback; controller and worker latch off across queued configure/session refresh until explicit listen.15s wall-clock timeout arms only when capture ready; changed recognition resets it, noise/[unk]/stale partials do not. Control loop also checks timeout during blocked native decode. Real owned-child/reader test verifies termination, stale output suppression and valid playback token. Epoch/request-tagged readiness/timeout events protect rapid toggles. UI/controller tests choosing/changing/unbinding/saved shortcut and stale events pass. Regressions failed before implementation and queued-reconfigure latch fix. npm run check39TS+58Python, strict types/lint; seven Python format checks and whitespace pass. README and ACCEPTANCE updated; live key delivery/loading not claimed.

phases.verification: Startup/response and microphone units are all source-verified. Numeric offline native model timings, negative-before/positive-after regressions, full39TS+58Python suite and formatter/whitespace checks pass. README/ACCEPTANCE retain first-use preparation cost and loaded/human/provider limitations. No dependency/config deployment, explicit reload, shared restart, live submission, physical microphone or binary edits performed.

Source-only response improvements are verified; actual human/provider timing and loaded-runtime acceptance require the separately gated rollout.
